_comment: Sessions the stacking benchmark runs against. Real S30 Pro captures on
Andreas' machine — paths are absolute and local by design: the corpus is a
developer artefact, and the data is far too large to live in the repo.
Chosen to span what actually varies, not to be a big list:
NGC 281   a long run that crosses midnight (1514 subs)
M 45      bright stars in reflection nebulosity — the case that broke
IC 1396A  the largest, and the drizzle re-validation target (2535)
READ-ONLY. The benchmark writes only into its --workdir; these folders hold
the only copies of several nights.
